title: A phone photo stored on its side is measured upright and cut to the crop's shape, never stretched
steps: S1: imageInfo (apps/tracy-web/src/opportunities/media-info.js) on a 1200x900 JPEG with EXIF orientation 6, then 8, then 1 and 3.
S2: cutForPlace (apps/tracy-web/src/lib/picture-cut.js) on a 1200x900 JPEG with EXIF orientation 6, crop {aspect 16/9, source 1200x675, output 640x360, strategy centre}.
expect: S1: orientations 6 and 8 give 900x1200; 1 and 3 give 1200x900.
S2: the cut is 640x360 and the region taken (rect) is 16:9 within 1%, inside 900x1200.

selectors.code: imageInfo turned size, cutForPlace one-factor fit

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: a 1200x900 orientation-6 JPEG cut for 16:9 used a 900x675 (4:3) region stretched to 640x360
fence: The planner reads the shown size, and a cut never changes the crop's shape before its fill resize

tests: a phone photo stored on its side is measured upright, as every cut turns it
a phone photo on its side with a crop planned from its stored size is cut to the crop’s shape, never stretched
